lines.en: Buzzing past the hive
Wings flapping, searching for a target
Rumble as it flies through the hive
Circling, surveying the surroundings
Flitting form, buzzing sound
Staring at the next prey
Issue a warning while flying
Fly by the hive's edge
Accelerate, buzzing along

lines.zh: 观察者之眼在空中飘动
lines.en: Eye of the Watcher floats in the air

lines.zh: 贴着密室顶壁慢慢滑行
lines.en: Sliding along the vault's ceiling.
Membrane taut, it circles a pillar.
It flies along the hive's veins.
It skims past without stirring air.
It switches places among the Watchers.
A pause in midair, then a turn.
Hovering above the hive
Circling quietly, vigilant
Stationary in mid-air, gazing afar
Occasionally make a rumble
Suspended, observing all
Floating quietly, awaiting instructions
Circling in the air, waiting to be activated
Hovering still, waiting for an enemy

lines.zh: 静静地漂浮，警惕着周围
lines.en: Floating silently, watching the surroundings
Suspended quietly, awaiting action
Its pupil narrows, then widens.
It clings to stone like a nail.
Stare at the player, ready to attack
Locking on to the player, ready to strike
Tracking the player, ready to strike
Staring at the player, waiting for an opportunity
Targeting the player, preparing to attack
Studying the player, searching for weaknesses

lines.zh: 注视玩家，准备发起攻击
lines.en: Fixing on the player, ready to attack

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，寻找可利用之处
lines.en: Staring at the player, looking for an advantage

lines.zh: 我用瞳孔量了量你的距离。
lines.en: My pupil measures the distance to you.
Staring at the player, assessing the threat

lines.zh: 它数清了你带了几把火把
lines.en: It counted every torch you carry.
Its gaze traces your armor's seams.
It meets your eyes and smiles first.
Your eyes...
My vision is obstructed!
You've got me!
You can't see me!

lines.zh: 我的眼膜裂了，看不清你！
lines.en: My eye membrane cracked; I can't see you!
You'll never find me!

lines.zh: 薄翼破了个洞，我飞不稳...
lines.en: A hole in my thin wing; I can't fly straight...
I need to hide!

lines.zh: 这具眼壳撑不住第二次！
lines.en: This eye-shell won't take another hit!
This eye can no longer see...

lines.zh: 你靠近了我，我会注视你更久。
lines.en: You approach, and I'll gaze upon you longer.

lines.zh: 看着我，你会变成我的一部分。
lines.en: Look at me, and you'll become part of me.

lines.zh: 你是我的猎物，注定要被吞噬。
lines.en: You're my prey, destined to be devoured.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，逃不过注视。
lines.en: What you hold won't escape my gaze.

lines.zh: 我的注视能让你变成蜂巢的一部分。
lines.en: My gaze will turn you into a part of the hive.

lines.zh: 你越靠近，我的力量越强。
lines.en: The closer you are, the stronger my power becomes.
Your fear makes me stronger.
You can't resist my power.

lines.zh: 我的注视会改变你的一切。
lines.en: My gaze will change everything about you.

lines.zh: 你是下一个进入蜂巢的生物。
lines.en: You're the next creature to enter the hive.

lines.zh: 不要碰我，我会看穿你的灵魂。
lines.en: Don't touch me, I'll see through your soul.

lines.zh: 你触碰了我，痛苦将伴随你。
lines.en: You've touched me, pain will accompany you.

lines.zh: 别靠近，我会追踪你的每一个动作。
lines.en: Stay away, I'll track every move you make.

lines.zh: 你触碰了我，现在感受我的注视。
lines.en: You've touched me, now feel my gaze.
My presence will tear you apart.

lines.zh: 你触碰了我，我会标记你。
lines.en: You've touched me, I'll mark you.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的眼柄，我记住了。
lines.en: You touched my eye stalk; I've noted it.

lines.zh: 你触碰了我，现在尝尝我的力量。
lines.en: You've touched me, taste my power now.
My presence will bring you pain.

lines.zh: 不要碰我，否则你会被注视。
lines.en: Don't touch me, or you'll be gazed upon.

lines.zh: 我的同伴，一起守护蜂巢。
lines.en: My mate, together we'll guard the hive.

lines.zh: 与我结合，成为蜂巢的一部分。
lines.en: Join me, become part of the hive.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，共同抵御外来者。
lines.en: My partner, together we repel intruders.
Guard the hive's honor together.

lines.zh: 与我结合，共创蜂巢未来。
lines.en: Combine with me, create the hive's future.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，共同对抗敌人。
lines.en: My partner, we'll fight together.

lines.zh: 与我结合，成为蜂巢的一员。
lines.en: Join with me, be part of the hive.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，一起守护蜂巢。
lines.en: My mate, together we protect the hive.
Combine with me, create greatness.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，一起守护家园。
lines.en: My partner, together we'll protect our home.
Buzz, something’s not right here.

lines.zh: 密室中的阴影，危险潜伏。
lines.en: Shadows in the watcher’s chamber.
Watcher’s eye activated, beware!
Buzz, beware, prey detected.
This hive is not a home.
Buzz, the queen has been sensed.
In the depths of the chamber.
Buzz, the hive’s will is strong.
Hive master, chamber king.
Buzz, leave me be.
Target observed, locking on.

lines.zh: 密室中的猎物，将被吞噬。
lines.en: Prey in the chamber, to be consumed.
Hive will, never giving up.
Buzz, target approaching.
Buzz, the queen is watching.
Nowhere to run in the chamber.
Buzz, target locked.
Hive will, not to be trespassed.
Buzz, this is the hive’s rule.
Watcher’s eye, never faltering.
Buzz, target acquired.
Enemy in the chamber, acquired.
Watcher’s eye, never swerving.
Buzz, target to be cleared.
All in the chamber are observed.
Buzz, hive will in action.
Watcher’s eye, consistent.
In the depths, waiting.

lines.zh: 嗡嗡，蜂巢意志支配一切。
lines.en: Buzz, hive will controls all.
Watcher’s eye, sees all.
I can see the path behind you.
The hive knows wherever you flee.

lines.zh: 发出一声低沉的咆哮，向你扑来。
lines.en: Growls lowly and lunges at you.

lines.zh: 用它锋利的爪子攻击你。
lines.en: Attacks you with its sharp claws.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀扇动，向你逼近。
lines.en: Its wings flap as it advances on you.

lines.zh: 眼睛闪烁着诡异的光芒。
lines.en: Its eyes glow eerily.
Plummets down from the air suddenly.

lines.zh: 挥舞着它的触手，准备攻击。
lines.en: W waves its tentacles, ready to attack.
Hisses and prepares for battle.

lines.zh: 用它的翅膀拍打你的脸。
lines.en: Pounds your face with its wings.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛变得异常巨大。
lines.en: Its eyes grow abnormally large.
Releases a thick cloud of black fog.
Rises slowly from the cave.

lines.zh: 我沿着蜂巢的墙慢慢浮行。
lines.en: I drift slowly along the hive's walls.
Flies out of the Watcher Chamber.
Patrols the high areas of the hive.
Occasionally rumbles loudly.

lines.zh: 你的火把晃了一下，我就到了。
lines.en: Your torch flickers, and there I am.

lines.zh: 用它的眼睛观察周围的环境。
lines.en: Uses its eyes to survey its surroundings.
Flies down from the top of the hive.

lines.zh: 我从密室顶上的缝里钻出。
lines.en: I slip out through a crack in the chamber roof.

lines.zh: 偶尔发出轻微的呼噜声。
lines.en: Occasionally makes a low growl.
The Watcher vault's light comes on.
The hive mind gains one more eye.
Fire consumes me...
The pain of falling...
Water drowned my eyes...
The shock of the explosion...

lines.zh: 眼睛破了，观者会替我出来。
lines.en: My eye broke — the Watcher will come out for me.
The power of magic...
Starvation consumes me...
Lightning burns through my membrane wings...

lines.zh: 虚空从我的眼眶往里灌。
lines.en: The void pours in through my eye sockets.
